notes: HISTORY: Sixteen-function unit 0x021431c4..0x021442dc: D1 and D0 from the out-of-line destructor, the eight helpers func_ov100_02143370..func_ov100_02143b68, CleanupResources, OnPendingDestroy, Render, Behavior, InitResources and OnAimedAtWithEgg.
Written in ROM order under `#pragma defer_codegen off`, which keeps D1 ahead of D0. None of the legacy shards carried a pragma.

The per-shard extern blocks are merged into one declaration per callee. Where shards disagreed on a callee's shape (dActor_c::Spawn's position by reference or pointer, data_ov100_02148008 as a Vector3 or three words, data_ov100_021486ac as a SharedFilePtr or an int array, the void/int return of func_02012694 and dCc_c::Update) the TU keeps one spelling; every caller reproduces with it.

func_ov100_0214344c, func_ov100_021437d4, func_ov100_02143aa4 and func_ov100_02143ae0 were C shards; they compile as C++ here, and their stack vectors are a plain three-word struct so they carry no destructor.

func_ov100_02143b68 copies the identity matrix through a twelve-word array struct; the C++ Matrix4x3 copy is the struct-copy DIFF described in notes/cpp-class-form.md (0x184 bytes for 0x148 inside this TU).
func_ov100_02143b18 and Behavior share one pointer-to-member pair type (ChompState: enter, execute) over a non-polymorphic stand-in class; the two legacy shards each spelled their own.

func_ov100_02143aa4 is the execute member of the only state (pointer-to-member constant data_ov100_02147ff8, copied by the module's static initializer into data_ov100_021486f4), with func_ov100_02143ae0 as its enter (data_ov100_02148000). Those constants follow daIbl_c's 31-slot vtable directly, which is where tu_map's daIbl_c tag and the old 'RollingIronBall_Kill' label came from.

include/types.h defines Vector3::~Vector3() inline and empty. The floor probe and Behavior take Vector3 locals and D1 tears down the two Vector3 arrays, so this TU emits that four-byte body once as vague linkage. The cartridge's copy is arm9:0x020072c0 (src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp); this object is not its home.

The same vague-linkage case for Vector3s, whose empty inline destructor is declared in include/types.h: D1 tears down mUnk_768 through __cxa_vec_cleanup with it. The cartridge keeps exactly one copy at arm9:0x02011508 (src/_ZN8Vector3sD1Ev.cpp); this object's four-byte `bx lr` copy is not its home.
